items.title: MECH-321 harm-aware selection, screened matched-abort seed pool (supersedes V3-EXQ-867a)
items.note: Third iteration of the MECH-321 harm-aware-selection task-effect test (844 -> 867 -> 867a -> 867b). Supersedes V3-EXQ-867a per failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-867a_2026-08-03 (confirmed, measurement_test_design_defect / non_contributory), which routed to /queue-experiment to grow the matched-seed pool. SAME QUESTION, SAME SUBSTRATE, SAME MANIPULATION, SAME BAR -- only the matched-pair sample size and the power guard move. WHAT 867a GOT RIGHT: the SD-029 hazard overlay + three-flag stream fix made the manipulation genuinely engage (harm_bias_engages met, 972 nonzero calls). WHAT FAILED: C1 ran on 2 matched (both_decompose) seeds with opposite-signed deltas (seed 11 -0.040, seed 23 +0.0125), netting -0.0139 against a 1xSE bar, while a correctly-EXCLUDED unmatched seed (47, on_only) showed a much larger beneficial +0.127. TWO DEFECTS FIXED. (1) The matched tier was set by CHANCE: a fixed 5-seed pool characterised by a darwin-arm64 --seed-scan that measured the ON ARM ONLY, at a reduced schedule, then run on a linux-x86_64 cloud worker. 867b instead SCREENS a 48-candidate pre-registered pool IN-PROCESS, both arms, on the machine that then measures it. The screen is SOUND, not heuristic: _run_cell at K episodes is a bit-identical PREFIX of the same cell at N>K (arm_cell resets all RNG at cell entry, env seeded per cell, nothing in the loop reads `episodes`) and PolicyDecomposition.reset() is explicitly NOT called on the agent's per-episode reset, so decomp_n_decomposed_midexec accumulates monotonically -- therefore screen-matched IMPLIES full-schedule matched. The converse does not hold, so a screen miss costs a candidate and never a false verdict. VERIFIED DIRECTLY 2026-08-03 (darwin-arm64, seed 11, both arms, 2ep vs 4ep x 12 steps): action_sequence prefix identical, all decomposition counters monotone; the manifest's screen_soundness_check re-tests this against the measurement rather than asserting it. (2) The power guard was VACUOUS, which is why n=2 scored as a verdict at all: 844/867/867a computed `n_pairs >= min(MIN_DECOMPOSING_SEEDS, len(both_decompose_seeds) or 1)`, and the min() collapses the pre-registered floor onto the OBSERVED count whenever n_pairs == len(both_decompose_seeds) (the normal case) -- so the `..._underpowered` branch was UNREACHABLE and the run fell through to the scored `weakens`. 867b deletes the softening, applies a HARD floor raised 2 -> 6, and stamps non_degenerate:false on an underpowered result so it is scoring-excluded rather than recorded as a direction. THE BAR IS UNCHANGED: EFFECT_SIZE_K_SIGMA=1.0, REL_IMPROVEMENT_FLOOR=0, and the _windowed_delta / _first_divergence_tick / _mean_at / fresh-selection-restricted C1 machinery are carried over verbatim from 844/867/867a. Moving the bar as well would be changing the question, not repairing the measurement. RUN SHAPE: PHASE S screens up to 48 candidates x 2 arms at 4x60, short-circuiting the ON cell when the OFF cell did not decompose (it cannot be matched then) unless the candidate is still needed as a zero-activity control; it exits early once 8 matched + 2 controls are found. PHASE M then measures a FIXED 10 seeds x 2 arms at the full 12x60 -- 8 matched slots (deterministically padded from the highest-activity unmatched candidates if the screen comes up short) plus 2 zero-activity negative controls retained from 867a so the run still DEMONSTRATES the attributability instrument. The fixed cell count is what keeps `seeds x conditions` = 20 verdict lines honest under an early-exiting screen. RUNNER DISPLAY CAVEAT: PHASE S is deliberately quiet w.r.t. the runner's progress patterns (no `ep N/M`, no `verdict:`) so the bar is driven only by PHASE M; the bar therefore sits at 0% for the screen (roughly the first third to half of wall clock) and `[screen] cand i/N ...` lines are the human-readable progress there. estimated_minutes is sized for both phases. FINGERPRINT CORRECTNESS (non-obvious, load-bearing): _config_slice takes `episodes` and writes it into schedule.episodes, because the screen and the measurement run the same (seed, arm) pairs at different schedules -- a shared slice would give a 4-episode screen cell and a 12-episode measurement cell the SAME fingerprint while holding different content, a false-reuse hazard for any future consumer of this mint. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout is the paired per-seed windowed harm delta over >= 6 matched seeds. Checked the only two recorded runs carrying it -- v3_exq_867a_..._20260802T203309Z_v3 (n=2 matched) and v3_exq_867_..._20260802T031937Z_v3 (manipulation structurally inert, no matched tier). Neither records nor permits deriving it at the required n: additional matched seeds are cells that were never run, not a reprocessing of banked ones. Not recoverable -> run. Arm-reuse against 867a's OFF mint would separately refuse on substrate_hash (ree_core has moved since 2026-08-02), so no try_reuse_cell call is made; this run's own ARM_SELECTION_OFF measurement cells are again minted reuse-ELIGIBLE (include_driver_script_in_hash=False). DV-SYMMETRY DECLARATION (both arms). DV = mean per-tick environment harm over the post-divergence window restricted to fresh e3-selection ticks; its symmetry group is permutation of the averaged ticks (a set-aggregate) plus any candidate-score transform preserving the selection argmax (broadcast additive constants, monotone rescalings). ARM_SELECTION_ON's manipulation is invariant under NEITHER: harm_bias applies a PER-LEAF penalty and select_harm_aware_leaves a categorical per-leaf override across the retiling candidates -- not a broadcast scalar -- so it moves the argmax and hence the committed action sequence, and it acts at selection time so it changes WHICH ticks occur rather than relabelling a fixed set. Confirmed empirically in 867a (both matched seeds diverged, divergence_tick=60, with differing per-seed harm means). ARM_SELECTION_OFF carries no manipulation at all, so the question does not arise there. RE-DERIVE BRAKE: MECH-321 counts 1 braking autopsy (threshold 2) -- does not fire. PRE-QUEUE CHECKS: validate_experiments.py --strict --paths OK with zero warnings of any class; dry-run smoke PASS end-to-end, including two added smoke assertions that the decisive readout is non-trivially engaged (ON arm decomp_n_harm_bias_nonzero=18 > 0, OFF arm == 0, i.e. a bit-identical no-op) -- a structural zero there is exactly 867's failure and is now caught in minutes rather than after a multi-hour grid. The toy-scale smoke correctly self-routes manipulation_inert_or_unmatched (no action-sequence divergence at 2 episodes x 12 steps); expected, not a defect. Smoke ran against a working tree carrying another session's uncommitted, ADDITIVE-ONLY edits to experiments/pack_writer.py and experiments/_lib/manifest_core.py (no write_flat_manifest signature change), so it is valid against committed HEAD too.

items.title: Q-004 tau_R calibration at larger training budget, selection-instrument fixed (supersedes V3-EXQ-149)
items.note: Q-004 replication at a larger training budget, per claims.yaml what_would_answer. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout not recoverable from any existing manifest -- EXQ-149 is the only prior run and cannot answer this (see defect below). Re-derive brake (2.5b): 0 failure_autopsy artifacts exist for Q-004/EXQ-149. CRITICAL FINDING during Step 3.5 code review: EXQ-149's action selection was unconditionally random.randint(...) in both training and eval, in every condition -- agent.e3.harm_eval() was trained but never consulted for selection, and residue_field.evaluate_trajectory() was never called. mean_harm under an RNG-only policy cannot depend on tau_R at ANY budget -- EXQ-149's identical-mean_harm finding is close to an arithmetic identity (DV-symmetry defect), not evidence of behavioural inertness. FIX (instrument repair, same claim/conditions/thresholds): action selection now routes through agent.hippocampal.propose_trajectories + agent.select_action (adapted from the already-reviewed V3-EXQ-120a pattern), giving tau_R two real causal channels into behavior (CEM candidate scoring vs residue terrain; E3 compute_residue_cost). Budget: WARMUP_EPISODES 300->600 (2x), EVAL_EPISODES 100->150 (1.5x) -- sized against a REAL timed calibration (10 warmup + 5 eval eps measured 32.2 sec/episode). New non-gating readiness diagnostics (R1 candidate_action_diversity>=1.5, R2 hippo_fallback_rate<0.5) guard against the fix silently degrading back to random selection. Smoke (--dry-run): all 6 cells complete, hippo_fallback_rate=0.0 everywhere, candidate_diversity_min 2.0-3.0, validate_experiments.py --strict 0 findings. Estimated ~40 hr total across 6 cells; machine_affinity=any per project convention.
